access_rules: Current map route demo reads only data/processed/route_grid/sample_corridor_jezero.parquet (2,128 cells near Gale Crater despite the filename).
Reject endpoints outside the corridor coverage instead of silently routing elsewhere.
Run A* on contiguous row/column cells in the saved corridor grid.
Do not serialize global rasters or NetCDF arrays as JSON for the browser.
Return route geometry, summary metrics, and limitations to JavaScript.
